About.title: About
About.body: I'm a Systems Engineering graduate from UTEPSA (2021–2026) in Santa Cruz, Bolivia. I like clear systems: schemas that hold up, calm interfaces, and code others can maintain. I've shipped Personal Memories as a live TypeScript product, built university software in .NET, supported systems/network labs, and competed in ICPC. I'm looking for remote roles where modern web craft meets reliable delivery.

UiLab.metaDescription: Internal gallery of UI variants for the Glacial portfolio.
UiLab.title: UI Lab
UiLab.subtitle: Compare patterns against a minimal, professional Glacial direction. Variants marked Recommended fit your brief best.
UiLab.intentBody: Prioritize clarity, calm surfaces, and a few intentional interactions. Prefer borders and spacing over shadows, pills, and decoration.

MotionLab.metaDescription: Internal gallery of motion variants for the Glacial portfolio.
MotionLab.title: Motion Lab
MotionLab.subtitle: Preview entrance, hover, and scroll animations. Use Replay to see each again. Recommended = fits your minimal, professional brief.
MotionLab.intent: Pick 2–3 motions total: hero stagger, card hover, optional scroll reveal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

fadeUp.title: Fade up
fadeUp.note: Already on hero. Calm, professional. 12px translate + opacity.

stagger.title: Staggered fade up
stagger.note: Role → name → tagline with 0.12s delays. Best hero pattern for you.

fadeIn.title: Fade in only
fadeIn.note: Even quieter than fade-up. Good for secondary text.

slideLeft.title: Slide from left
slideLeft.note: Slightly editorial. OK for section headings, not whole page.

slideUpSoft.title: Soft slide up
slideUpSoft.note: More travel than fade-up. Use sparingly on one block.

cardHover.title: Card border + accent bar
cardHover.note: Project cards: border brightens, bar grows. No shadow.

linkUnderline.title: Underline grow
linkUnderline.note: Nav or inline links. Subtle, not default underline always on.

buttonHover.title: CTA color shift
buttonHover.note: secondary → primary on hover, 300ms. Matches current buttons.

scrollReveal.title: Reveal on scroll
scrollReveal.note: Sections after hero fade/slide in once when ~35% visible.

smoothScroll.title: Smooth scroll anchors
smoothScroll.note: Already enabled on html. Enough for one-page nav.

bounce.title: Bounce in
bounce.note: Playful / landing-page generic. Clashes with Glacial.

pulse.title: Infinite pulse
pulse.note: Draws attention but feels noisy on a portfolio.

pick.sections: Optional: scroll reveal on Experience / Projects
